videos.title: Cave Log 03 — Teaser
videos.description: Deep underground, a lone explorer is trapped in an increasingly hostile passage. This teaser for the final Cave Log episode brings isolation, claustrophobia and the fear of something unseen to breaking point.

videos.title: Cave Log 02
videos.description: Lost in the cave system, Aitor hears unexplained sounds drawing closer. Evidence of an earlier expedition changes the nature of his journey as his sense of direction begins to collapse.

videos.title: Cave Log 01
videos.description: A solo cave explorer loses track of the way back. The passages narrow, the journey becomes more physical, and an unidentified sound is recorded somewhere behind him.

videos.title: The Basement Files
videos.description: An open door leads down a narrow staircase into a dark basement. A found-footage descent built around silence, uneasy camera movement and the fear of what remains unseen.

videos.title: Jarjacha
videos.description: A distant animal crosses an isolated Andean landscape at dusk. Its shape seems familiar, until the way it moves stops making sense. A found-footage short inspired by Andean folklore.

videos.title: La Llorona
videos.description: A driver encounters a solitary figure on an empty road at night. Dashcam imagery and low visibility turn a distant woman in white into an unsettling encounter inspired by Latin American folklore.

videos.title: Ghost Kitchen
videos.description: A fixed camera records an ordinary kitchen. A small visual anomaly gradually becomes impossible to ignore, turning a familiar domestic space into a scene of quiet unease.

videos.title: The Follower
videos.description: An ordinary late-night walk through a quiet park becomes a fragmented personal recording of fear. Close handheld framing follows a woman who realizes she may not be alone.

videos.title: NO PLANS
videos.description: An ordinary afternoon quietly becomes something else: changes of clothes, a camera shutter and small gestures between photographs. An intimate glimpse into the moments when the camera is supposed to be off.

videos.title: A Little Longer
videos.description: A light left on, a quiet room and a moment that does not need to end. Alura Thorne explores desire, anticipation and the invitations that remain unspoken.

videos.title: Beside You
videos.description: A kind gesture, a familiar song and an unexpected connection make a quiet day feel less lonely. An intimate short about everyday kindness and the comfort of having someone beside you.

videos.title: Balance
videos.description: Through quiet gestures and fleeting thoughts, Alura reflects on what to hold on to and what to release. A character short about control, letting go and knowing what matters.

videos.title: Stay
videos.description: Something small brings a memory back, carrying Alura to a moment and a version of herself she thought she had left behind. For a moment, she lets it stay.

videos.title: Rituals
videos.description: Morning light, coffee, fabric and small gestures reveal Alura through her everyday rituals. A quiet character study told through body language, detail and visual rhythm.

videos.title: Costa Brava
videos.description: Alura moves through a Mediterranean coastal town in the warm evening light. Elegant movement and intimate details connect character with the atmosphere of the Costa Brava.

videos.title: Come Closer
videos.description: Intimate rituals, fleeting encounters and quiet decisions introduce the world of Alura Thorne. An atmospheric trailer for a character who lives by her own rules.

site.title: Independent Film & Creative Production
site.description: Lanius Films is an independent audiovisual studio in Barcelona. Film direction, creative production, narrative films, branded concepts, AI filmmaking and post-production.
site.hero_intro: An independent audiovisual studio shaping narrative films, branded concepts and cinematic character worlds. From direction and creative development to AI filmmaking and the final master.
site.about_lead: Lanius Films is an independent audiovisual studio based in Barcelona, working across film direction, creative production, AI filmmaking and post-production.
site.about_copy: Led by filmmaker Jorge Sánchez, the studio brings 10+ years of production and post-production experience to narrative films, self-initiated branded concepts and ongoing cinematic worlds. Each piece is shaped as a complete audiovisual work: story, image, performance, music, voice and sound.
site.about_process: Projects move from concept and visual development through production, editing, colour and sound. Generative tools are part of that process, guided by cinematic direction, continuity and the craft of the final finish.
site.contact_copy: For creative teams, brands and collaborators. Get in touch about film direction, creative production, branded concepts, AI filmmaking and post-production.
